content: The dissertation says the R. Ḥurūf was written at the request of a dignitary, 'perhaps Iskandar Mīrzā' and was completed on 10 Ramaḍān 817/23 November 1414 in Shiraz; footnote 15 adds that this is shortly after Iskandar's rebellion against Shāhrukh was violently quashed. A copy appears to have been sent that year to Sayyid Niẓām al-Dīn Aḥmad.
